cues.text: The Velvet Room. Igor sits at his table, hands folded, Elizabeth standing beside him.
The room flashes white. When it clears, a card spins in the air before you, circled by streams of light.
The card bursts in a flash, and everything goes white again.
Above the room's doors, the hands of a clock spin wildly, then slow and stop. The doors slide open onto a blank white void, with Igor and Elizabeth waiting before it.
